name: auto_market_research
purpose: Read-only market research in one call: search the catalog and inspect matching public settled deals, with optional own purchase history. Query and category filter catalog and deal results; shop filters the public results by seller and personal history by shop. Returns counts and recent matches.
evidence: made by tool_forge.py: A combined catalog and public-deal lookup can cover the repeated scan/search/lookup/ledger pattern in one call, and an optional purchase-history slice reduces the extra personal-history call. The output reports matches and rows rather than giving buying advice.
